children: fell 0.9% in Wednesday's trading after a Luxembourg court issued an order prohibiting parent company Ardagh Holdings from proceeding with a sale of all or part of its interests in the metal packaging business.
The order followed an application by certain minority holders of senior secured notes issued by ARD Finance, a former parent of Ardagh Group.

Creditors including Arini Capital Management and Canyon Capital Advisors took control of Ardagh last year after a lengthy debt restructuring aimed at tackling more than $7.9B of liabilities and pushing out near-term maturities; Ardagh Metal Packaging
was a key prize in that battle.
The company said it is "vigorously challenging the order and has made an application for it to be withdrawn."

title: Ardagh blocked by court from selling metals packaging unit
